prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism is consistent with the kind and force of the impact. Over the course of 23 visits, care was delivered in a standard progression of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graded activity. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as function returned toward baseline. Examination revealed reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the diagnosed strain. Certain neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar spine is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicate entries. Prognosis is good with continued home program adherence, and discharge from active care is anticipated.
